payload.text: **The sweep is not done until every consumer's CI is green on the pushed commit** (hv, via laksa-vc, 2026-09-19). The 2026-09-16 sweep reached Laksa as d17c680bb, committed with --no-verify and pushed with a later commit on 2026-09-18. Laksa's CI went red (run 35372280187, AT-07.14: its test fakes the parent's seal ledger with DEVBIN_SEAL_LEDGER alone, and record_seal as designed gives an unowned ledger every row), and nobody read it from 17:13Z on the 18th until today. devbin behaved as designed; Laksa's dc is fixing the test. For the next sweep's checklist: after each estate's push, 'gh run list --limit 1' in that repo must read green on the pushed sha, or the estate is named as open. A --no-verify commit skips the consumer's suite, so its CI is the only reader left. It sits beside todo 76(a), which is the same rule for devbin's own pushes.
